title: The first-seen day for a follow-up reminder is not reset when its due date moves
evidence: ios/engine/reminders.ts:79-83: the first-seen key is `${category}:${kind}` and does not include the due date, so a kept day survives a change of due date. When a newer result moves the due date, `startOf` returns the kept day or the new due date, whichever is later, and a new due date already in the past then waits for the next step. Worked case (PR 1387's PSA repeat rule): PSA 4.5 on 2026-04-01, first seen on 2026-07-02 and kept; a vague PSA dated 2026-06-01 entered on 2026-10-15 makes it due 2026-09-01, and the first alert is 2026-11-30, 46 days after the phone first sees the new item. Not a regression: the code before PR 1387 gave the same day. Found by the PR 1387 review on 2026-11-13. The fix is reminder timing, so its design goes to the owner before any build.
